description: This file defines the TraceUriGenerator class, which generates trace URIs based on given paths to support logging and tracing within the Eclipse Ditto project. The class includes regex pattern matching for different API paths, methods for generating trace information, normalization of paths, and handling of special cases like messages or health status.

classes.name: TraceUriGenerator
classes.description: A utility class that generates trace URIs for logging/tracing purposes based on request paths, with methods to normalize paths and extract trace information. Implements Function<String, TraceInformation> for functional use.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Generates trace information for a given path by matching patterns and extracting relevant parts to create a TraceInformation object.

methods.name: extractTraceInformation
methods.description: Normalizes the path and applies regex patterns to extract trace identifiers and tags.
